question: Reeta is standing facing south-east. First, she turns 135° clockwise. After that, she turns 90° anticlockwise. Then she turns 45° clockwise, followed by a 135° anticlockwise turn. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) Reeta is standing facing south-east. First, she turns 135° clockwise. After that, she turns 90° anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e93ca4c51808a2f11e92dcc58909bffb9b20b739d88eac534a1d61a143d69c48.png] 

2) Then she turns 45° clockwise, followed by a 135° anticlockwise turn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee53bb98ba07c2373c2daf4f814240ec2ebb70b17b2a8fafe811108093436551.png] 

∴ Here, At last Reeta is facing towards 'East'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"East".**
